node: AI/data-center and broad electrification load growth
summary: Expanded the universe around the AI/data-center load-growth node toward second-order chokepoints: electrical construction labor, custom switchgear/power distribution, utility grid hardware, backup/on-site power generation, and grid-edge software. The strongest candidates in this pass are companies whose revenues or backlog are already tied to data-center, utility, substation, or mission-critical power demand rather than only broad AI compute spending. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
